C313.notes: Copper-nickel, non-magnetic type (the magnetic steel version is the following year's issue). OPEN FLAG: the mint monogram - Moscow or Leningrad - cannot be resolved at the photo's magnification and is NOT guessed; it changes the catalog value, so the estimate uses the lower figure. Reverse photo only.
C313.mint: mint monogram under РУБЛЕЙ on this side, too small to read in the phone photo (ММД Moscow or ЛМД Leningrad)
C313.story: A 1992 Russian 20 roubles, from the first year of coins after the Soviet Union ended. This side carries the value between two branches, with the date below; the other side shows a double-headed eagle.
